tutorial-texto: Player A uses A/D and player B uses the ←/→ arrow keys. The goal is to avoid falling and keep your balloons from popping.
cinematica-parrafo1: At the dawn of time, the fish society performed chthonic rituals to obtain pleasures, but it did not know what was about to happen.
cinematica-parrafo2: Cthulhu arrived and brought chaos with him, destroying the fish society, but a few offerings changed the course of history.
cinematica-parrafo3: Cthulhu ended up adoring the fish society's traditional food and reduced the sacrifices to just one per year.
cinematica-parrafo4: The fish society decided to settle the sacrifices with bubble duels, so that only the most capable survives and contributes more to society.
cinematica-parrafo5: The new champions of the duel that will decide who is sacrificed to Cthulhu have been chosen: you and your best friend!
